values.meaning: AP gained per stack of Phenomenal Evil
stacks gained per enemy champion hit by an ability
values.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Phenomenal Evil'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by his {{tip|abilities}}

values.meaning: stacks gained on an enemy champion takedown
values.quote: 5 stacks whenever he scores an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}}

mechanics.claim: Ability hits and takedown stacks combine, so an ability-secured takedown grants both hit and takedown stacks (6 total, or 7 with Baleful Strike's extra hit stack).
mechanics.quote: The two effects stack, granting 6 stacks for each enemy champion taken down by an ability, 7 with {{ai|Baleful Strike|Veigar}}.

mechanics.claim: Stacks are granted for hitting an enemy champion regardless of whether damage or any effect actually occurs.
mechanics.quote: '''Veigar's''' abilities do not have to deal damage nor affect their targets to grant a stack.
